text: I’m looking for tape-in human hair extensions in a silky straight texture, with lengths from 16 to 24 inches and weights of 30g, 40g, or 50g, designed to add full-head thickness without shedding, tangling, or smelling.
I need 14-inch water wave passion twist crochet hair made from heat-set synthetic fiber, preferably in natural black or brown, with enough packs and strands for a full head plus a crochet needle.
I’m looking for 14-inch curly wavy Senegalese twist crochet braids made from Kanekalon fiber, with about 85g per pack, 28 roots per pack, and five to seven packs for a full head.
I want reusable heat-resistant synthetic hair extensions with a soft, bouncy, human-hair-like texture that are handmade, odorless, and safe for the skin.
I’m looking for a lace-front human hair wig for women, available in light brown, with a natural hairline and styling options for long, straight, braided, or curly looks.

I need 8-inch short passion twist crochet hair in a curly Marlybob texture, with 9 bundles per pack, soft tangle-free fiber, and colors such as natural black, ombre blonde, ombre brown, gray, or highlighted brown.
I’m looking for a thick, soft, smooth headband wig with a velcro snapping design that can be worn as a ponytail or bun without tangling, shedding, odor, or lice.
I need 100% unprocessed hair extension bundles in lengths from 8 to 28 inches, with 100g per bundle, to create longer, fuller hair for daily wear or special occasions.
I’m looking for 10-inch textured clip-in hair extensions with curls or kinks, sold as a 9-piece set.
I want Brazilian kinky straight virgin human hair in natural color, available from 10 to 28 inches, with bundle or closure options for a full head and dyeable shades.
I’m looking for light pink synthetic clip-in hair extensions made from washable, permable fiber, with 10 highlighted pieces for quick costume or fashion styling.
I need a burgundy red straight synthetic hair weave bundle in 18-, 20-, 22-, or 24-inch lengths, made from heat-resistant high-temperature fiber that can be curled or straightened.
I’m looking for 30 colorful 21.6-inch clip-in synthetic hair extensions made from heat-resistant fiber for parties, festivals, costumes, or everyday creative styling.
I want double-weft Remy human hair extensions with shiny, smooth strands that blend naturally, resist tangling, and can be styled into different looks.

I need 18-inch goddess faux locs crochet hair in a river-locs texture, made from soft lightweight synthetic fiber, with six packs, 144 strands per pack, a crochet needle, and hair beads for a full head.
I’m looking for curly Remy human hair clip-in extensions with soft, silky strands and secure, scalp-friendly clips sized for comfortable everyday wear.
I want a clip-in human hair extension topknot designed for a man’s undercut style, with flexible volume that can be dyed when selected in natural black and styled into different looks.
I need 12-inch ombre box braid crochet hair made from soft, lightweight fiber with 24 pre-looped roots per piece, four pieces per pack, and protective packaging.
I’m looking for 120g clip-in human hair extensions in a seven-piece set designed for full-head coverage, with securely sewn scalp-friendly clips for easy application and removal.
I want 50cm multicolored synthetic party highlight extensions with 10 separately clipped pieces, made from heat-resistant fiber in assorted bright colors for cosplay, costumes, and events.
I’m looking for jumbo ombre synthetic braiding hair in black, deep brown, or light brown, with a soft, tangle-free texture that is reusable and comes in five-piece lots with free dreadlock ends.
I need 10-inch natural-color Cambodian human hair bundles weighing about 300g total, with dyeable hair and air or express shipping.
I’m looking for Indi Remi weaving hair made from healthy, shiny, bouncy strands with high elasticity and minimal processing for long-lasting wear.
I want 16- to 24-inch #30 tape-in human hair extensions with a silky straight texture and 30g, 40g, or 50g weights, providing thick full-head coverage without shedding, tangling, or odor.
I need one piece of deep wave human hair extensions in natural black, available from 14 to 24 inches.
I’m looking for 4-piece Remy human hair clip-in extensions in 12- to 18-inch lengths, totaling 58g to 68g, that attach quickly and blend naturally for daily or special-occasion wear.
I need 22-inch passion twist crochet hair made from soft, lightweight, flame-retardant synthetic fibers, with 80g and 22 strands per pack and seven packs per lot.

I’m looking for a 6D real-hair extension system that installs a full head in about 20 minutes without electricity, tape, glue, chemicals, or clips, and can be washed, curled, straightened, and styled normally.
I want a single soft, lightweight, washable high-temperature fiber hair extension clip in 18- or 22-inch length for parties, concerts, weddings, shopping, or daily wear.
I need a 14-inch natural-color Brazilian human hair bundle weighing about 100g, with dyeable hair and air or express shipping.
